title: Pulse Cumulative Reconsideration
page0: Push the cumulative MOOR mechanism into Project Pulse without throwing away Pulse's existing Refinery, Capability Memory, Funnel handoff, reference spine, factory graph, or verified history. New verified capability must reconsider only relevant existing machinery, preserve failures, promote tested relationships, surface repeated verified patterns, and remain under the singular Funnel's authority.
correctedQuestion: How should Pulse's already-working Refinery evolve so every verified CapabilityDelta creates a bounded relevance field over existing machines instead of rescanning every historical pair, while preserving negative evidence and allowing repeated verified relationships to become candidate abstractions?
currentReality: Pulse already has MOOR Refinery, Capability Memory, Assembly Core, Funnel Capability Handoff, a reference spine, a factory graph, and a Capability Memory UI.
Capability Memory currently calls inferCandidates after ingestion, and inferCandidates scans every active verified capability against every other active verified capability.
Pulse already distinguishes candidate-unverified compositions from machine-verified compositions and requires evidence for promotion.
Capability supersession is already append-preserving through lifecycle deprecation rather than deletion.
preserve: existing Crystal Bundles, capabilities, compositions, adapters, usage events, supersession lineage and Funnel authority

supersedes.rule: Capability Graph updated → all compatible composition candidates inferred
supersedes.replacement: Capability Graph updated → only the verified delta is reconsidered against relevant existing machinery; a full all-capability audit remains an explicit diagnostic, not the ingestion path.

materialQuestions: What is the smallest delta that should trigger reconsideration?
What deterministic evidence makes an old machine relevant to the new delta?
How do exact typed contracts remain strong evidence without letting generic any-type compatibility manufacture fake relationships?
How are failed combinations retained and recalled on future relevant deltas?
When can a candidate connection be promoted to verified?
When do repeated verified connections justify an abstraction candidate without silently becoming law?
How does Pulse expose the delta, relevant machines, candidates, recalled failures and abstraction candidates as live project state?
How does the singular Funnel remain the authority while Refinery stays cumulative but non-authoritative?

answer.ingestLaw: A verified Crystal Bundle appends its new verified capability records, then reconsiderDelta compares only those records with active existing machinery and with one another. Existing-existing pairs are not rescanned during routine ingestion.
relevanceLaw: exact output/input type match is strong deterministic relevance
verified adapter match is strong deterministic relevance
declared provides/requires match is strong deterministic relevance
generic any-type compatibility is weak and cannot create a candidate without additional domain relevance
generic architecture words such as capability, system, tool, component, reusable and version do not count as domain evidence
answer.evidenceLaw: Candidate compositions remain candidate-unverified. Only machine/human/canonical evidence may promote them.
answer.failureLaw: LearningCapsule failures become first-class reusable negative evidence. Future relevant deltas recall matching failures rather than rediscovering them.
answer.abstractionLaw: Three or more verified compositions with the same typed relationship may surface a candidate abstraction. It is not law and causes no automatic rewrite.
answer.pulseLaw: Capability Memory UI and Pulse Spine display/retain reconsiderations, failures and abstraction candidates. The factory graph can render them because they are canonical memory records, not decorative invented nodes.

acceptance: Ultra Funnel produces verifiable BlueprintReceipt and ExecutionReceipt for this Pulse correction.
Routine verified bundle ingestion calls bounded delta reconsideration rather than all-pairs candidate inference.
An exact typed new producer/consumer pair creates candidate composition evidence.
A generic any-type sink does not become a candidate solely because it accepts any type.
Failure evidence from LearningCapsule persists in Capability Memory and Pulse references.
Candidate composition promotion still requires verified evidence.
Repeated verified typed relationships surface an abstraction candidate but do not become law.
Pulse Capability Memory visibly shows reconsideration, failure evidence and abstraction candidates.
Pulse Spine indexes cumulative failures, reconsiderations and candidate abstractions.

noScrapVerdict.keep: Existing Pulse Refinery, memory schema concepts, Funnel handoff, Assembly Core, Pulse Spine, Capability Memory UI, factory graph and accumulated local history.
noScrapVerdict.change: Routine candidate inference trigger, memory schema normalization, failure/reconsideration records, abstraction detection, Pulse visibility and metadata.
noScrapVerdict.duplicateNothing: Do not add a second Pulse cumulative database or another Funnel. Evolve the existing Capability Memory.
